objective: Test whether joint rendering-center and cropped-support depth consistency improves safe native-a6 handoff on the complete fixed lower PVD domain.

domain.source: original fixed lower evidence, no new masks

action: Exact conditional native-a6 mass crop inside the existing 36-cell lower-body corridor; persistent native-ID coefficients; all components jointly composite in their native order
reference: Frozen lower-PVD independent alpha-weighted camera depth, unbinned and computed without parent occlusion; a proposal reference, not hidden ground truth

qualification.construction: 40 BUILD frames; all contributions use parent joint alpha*T times physical crop fraction
qualification.distinct_frame_definition: Frames with corresponding C or CM front contribution; each rule counted separately
qualification.protected_domain: (observed a6 RGB OR fixed original outside domain OR valid measured a6 depth) excluding fixed target
qualification.C: at least 80% of target crop contribution has native rendered center depth < proposal depth - 12cm
qualification.CM: at least 80% has both rendered center and conditional mode after inherited halfspace AND physical crop in front of the same reference
qualification.protection: qualification uses only the part being cropped; a mixed native row can retain its support outside the physical corridor
qualification.limits: Missing observations are not free space. No semantic identity truth, opaque first hit, new surface/color fitting or learned policy.

arms.center_matched: C-qualified IDs at coefficient 0.5 * BUILD target crop mass(CM) / BUILD target crop mass(C), equal first-order BUILD target retirement to dual

primary_comparison: dual versus center_matched: same physical operator and first-order BUILD target dose; protected-domain/RGB/depth damage per actual lower visibility gain. Only dual is the predeclared deployment candidate; no post-hoc winner selection among controls.
dose_limit: Dose matching uses parent first-order contribution, not equal post-intervention transmittance or reveal. Raw center and unqualified corridor are diagnostics.
held_scope: Repeated mechanism diagnostics, not untouched validation. Coefficients BUILD-only; full49 guards veto deployment.
acceptance: positive incremental full49 lower contribution in black and delete-a37 street
all inherited per-frame black and both street RGB/alpha/road/seam guards
fixed measured a6 group-exterior depth mean absolute parent change <= 0.005m per frame/state
no protected-domain per-pixel RGB change above 0.05 (a6/outside and inherited street road/other/a37 masks)
explicit saved zero fallback when any full49 guard fails
falsification: If no nonzero qualified dose exists, label inapplicable. If dual removes center-mode disagreements but has no better protection than dose-matched center, do not claim consistency solved mixed support; stop scalar tuning and examine retained/replaced geometry.
smoke: real GPU no-op output parity all states
constant per-row strength equals existing volume renderer
